Name: More KeyBinding
Author: SorryLate
Description:
[b]More Keybinding
[/b]This mod add keybinding for screenshot, zoom out/in, sort inventory item, move same item to chest.

[b]Note :
[/b]Screenshot will be saved in default screenshot stardewvalley folder / you can access it by click [b]"Open Folder Destination"[/b] in SDV setting
You can edit, the keybind in config.json

[b]Config :[/b]
TakeScreenshot =[i] default is [b]CTRL + K [/b]
[/i]ZoomIn = [i]default is [b]CTRL + L[/b][/i]
ZoomOut = [i]default is [b]CTRL + J[/b][/i]
SortInventory = [i]default is [b]CTRL + Q[/b][/i]
StackToChest = [i]default is [b]CTRL + R[/b]
[/i]PetAnimal = [i]default is [b]CTRL + P[/b][/i]
OpenAnimalDoors = [i]default is [b]CTRL + O[/b][/i]
ClosedAnimalDoors = [i]default is [b]CTRL + C[/b][/i]
[b]

All SDV Modders
